textRun.content: Dose to Data App Store Screenshot Gallery
Present Dose to Data as a calm, understandable medication and symptom-tracking tool, with each screenshot focused on one clear user benefit.
informed the concise, benefit-led storytelling and the idea of adding motion later.
informed the soft gradient backgrounds and approachable visual hierarchy.
Use varied blue, mint, lavender, blush, and peach gradients while keeping the app UI itself clear and inspectable.
Turn daily check-ins into clear trends
Check in in under a minute
Bring the full picture to appointments
Apple places App Preview videos before screenshots on iPhone, even when they are rearranged. Keep this gallery screenshot-only if the trends-led message must remain first.
The current app target supports iPad, so a separate 13-inch iPad screenshot set is also required.
1320 x 2868 px, RGB, no alpha; representative demo data only.
